content.short: A next-generation Web3 AppStore and GameFi hub built on the DERWA framework for seamless Web2 to Web3 onboarding.
content.description:
Adappt is a next-generation Web3 AppStore and GameFi hub built on the Digital Entertainment Real-World Asset (DERWA) framework. It provides tools to onboard traditional Web2 projects into the Web3 ecosystem in just three days. The platform enables true tokenized ownership of digital entertainment assets, fostering a transparent and user-centric gaming environment.

Users can participate in incentive systems like NFT mining pools, token airdrops, and missions to reward engagement. Adappt also hosts seasonal competitions and quests to drive traffic and exposure for both Web2 and Web3 communities globally.
